none: PAS BERK-0993FE: Roman coin: Nummus of Magnentius
contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete but slightly corroded copper alloy nummus (AE2) of Magnentius (AD 350-353), dating to the period c.AD 351-352. Reece period 18. VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAE reverse type, with two standing figures of Victory holding a shield between them with the inscription VOT / V / MVLT / X. Cf. RIC Vol. VIII, p.122, no.14
